# AegisLex — Phase 4: Cases Localization Report

## Files Modified

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `cases-list.component.ts` | Injected LanguageService; `statusOptions`, `typeOptions`, `priorityOptions`, `getPriorityConfig`, `getStatusConfig` now use `lang.t()`; `formatDate` is locale-aware; toast calls localized |
| `cases-list.component.html` | 30 `lang.t()` bindings replacing all hardcoded English UI strings |
| `case-detail.component.ts` | Injected LanguageService; `tabs` computed with `lang.t()`; `getRiskDesc`, `docCountLabel`, toast calls, `formatDate` localized |
| `case-detail.component.html` | 42 `lang.t()` bindings; all tab labels, section headers, buttons, empty states, quick actions |
| `case-form.component.ts` | Injected LanguageService; `caseTypes`, `priorities` computed with `lang.t()`; `fieldError` returns localized error messages; toast calls localized |
| `case-form.component.html` | 28 `lang.t()` bindings; all form labels, placeholders, hints, buttons, tips panel |

## What Was Localized

### cases-list
- Page title and subtitle (`Cases`, `{n} total cases · {n} shown`)
- "New Case" button
- Search placeholder and aria-label
- Filter dropdowns: All Statuses / Types / Priorities + each option label
- View toggle aria-labels (List view / Grid view)
- Table column headers: Case, Type, Client, Priority, Status, Risk, Updated
- Priority badge labels (Critical / High / Medium / Low)
- Status badge labels (Active / Pending / Review / Closed / Archived)
- Risk Score label on grid cards
- Action button tooltips: View, Chat with Saul
- Delete action aria-label
- Delete confirmation dialog: title, body, Cancel, Delete Case
- Pagination: "Page {n} of {n}", prev/next aria-labels
- Empty state: "No cases found", filter hint, create hint
- Toast: "Case deleted successfully", "Case archived"
- `formatDate` → locale-aware (`en-US` / `ar-AE`)

### case-detail
- Back link label
- Header action buttons: Ask Saul, Upload, Analyze All
- Risk banner: "Risk Score", description (High/Medium/Low), "View Analysis"
- All 5 tab labels: Overview, Documents, Analysis, Timeline, Graph
- Overview section: Case Details, all field labels (Type/Priority/Status/Client/Created/Updated/Description/Tags)
- Quick Actions card: title and all 4 items (Generate Report / View Timeline / Legal Graph / Similar Cases) with descriptions
- Documents tab: header `Documents ({n})`, "Add Document", empty state, "Upload First Document", "Uploaded" date label
- Analysis tab: "AI Analysis", "Run Analysis", empty state, toast messages
- Timeline tab redirect: title, description, "Open Full Timeline"
- Graph tab redirect: title, description, "Open Full Graph"
- Document count helper: "1 document" vs "n documents"
- `formatDate` → locale-aware

### case-form
- Page title and subtitle
- Back link
- All form labels and placeholders: Case Title, Description, Case Type, Priority, Client Name, Tags
- Form hints for title and tags
- All 6 case type option labels
- All 4 priority option labels
- Tag remove/add aria-labels
- Cancel button, Create Case button, "Creating..." loading state
- Validation error messages (required, minlength)
- Getting Started tips panel: title + 4 steps with descriptions
- Toast: "Case created"

## What Was NOT Localized (per spec)

- `case_.title`, `case_.caseNumber`, `case_.clientName` — user data
- `case_.description` — user-entered content
- `case_.tags[]` — user-entered content
- `casesByType` / `casesByStatus` label values from mock data
- Case number format (CASE-2024-xxx) — system identifier
